recipes.title: Slow Cooker Chipotle Queso Steak & Rice (10 Meals)

items.i: chipotle peppers in adobo, to taste
high-protein chipotle queso (his recipe is in his comments/eBook)

steps: Season the steak and add to the slow cooker with the Rotel, broth and chipotle.
Cook on low about 8 hours (or high 4–5) until it shreds.
Shred the steak in the juices.
Stir in the dry minute rice, cover and cook until tender (about 20–30 minutes), adding a little broth if dry.
Stir in the cheese and queso until creamy, then portion into 10 containers.
recipes.notes: Ingredients come from the on-screen text; the full recipe and the queso are sent by DM, so cook times and the queso are estimated. Calories and protein (about 600 cal, 53–55 g) are his; carbs and fat are estimates.
